content: Scatter plots for lay users: research (Xiong et al., 'Illusion of Causality in Visualized Data', VIS 2019) shows causality ratings are LOWEST for scatter plots vs bar charts and text — scatter is the least causally-suggestive encoding, good fit for non-causal framing. Standard guidance: correlation != causation messaging, jitter/opacity for overplotting of discrete scales, avoid trend lines if avoiding causal implication.
